# gitlink (mode 160000). Complements the gitleaks secrets gate in quality.yml.
# Detection is a `shell: python` step to avoid CRLF-in-bash issues on this Windows repo.

- name: crcp reports must stay deny-by-default
# tools/crcp/reports/ holds live auth / session / health dumps (one of them has
# carried a value-shaped `sk-…` string). Its .gitignore must DENY the whole tree
# and re-admit only the human-written .md narratives, so a merely-renamed dump
# cannot be committed by accident. A name-by-name allowlist fails OPEN.
# Both-states gate: MUST_IGNORE catches removal/weakening of the deny patterns;
# MUST_SEE catches an over-broad rewrite that also swallows the .md narratives.
# Every probe path is synthetic and untracked, so the check is index-independent.
# --no-index so an already-tracked path cannot skew the answer; check-ignore
# exits 0 when the path IS ignored, 1 when it is not.
